calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' 
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 18 AND 21
  AND s.store_id < 900
  AND p.category != 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY SUM(f.net_amount) DESC
LIMIT 10
